criteria.candidate_readiness: HOLD while any mandatory contract is indefinite or blocking precision remains unapproved; approval package must identify all obligations, domains, oracles, alternative evidence and exact hashes. Runtime PASS count is not a readiness criterion.
criteria.conformance: Current §37 unchanged. Any future profile-based declaration requires express normative approval, no undefined mandatory obligation, every mandatory sufficiency row SATISFIED_BY_EVIDENCE or a true normative scope exception, all required runtime cases/evidence accepted, and closure of blocking P0/P1.
criteria.interoperability: Separate approval and independent implementations, frozen reference set/corpus first; matching one implementation against partial oracles is insufficient.
criteria.suspend_on_counterevidence: A reproducible P0/P1, invalid source/oracle, contradicted mandatory rule or invalidated evidence suspends the affected declaration pending explicit review; expectations cannot be silently changed.

decision_reason: G00 prevents rigorous identification of all inherited mandatory content. Closing the bounded familiar policy precisions alone is insufficient.
